help.chrome_lead: Pair the tafs extension with your phone and a taf can work in your Chrome, only on the sites you allow. It works in its own tabs, and anything that needs your yes waits for you in {needs_you}.
help.chrome_manage: {account} › {chrome} lists your Chromes and what each one is used for. Unpairing a Chrome ends its connections.
help.chrome_title: tafs can work in your Chrome
help.code_lead: Turn it on in {account} › {sign_in}. Then, when you ask, KIFF emails a code that works once, for 10 minutes, in the browser that asked.
help.code_safe: Never give this code to anyone. KIFF will never ask you for it.
help.code_title: Sign in with a code sent by email
